about: Dispatcher assistant eval (spec §8.5 rows 1–38 as s01–s38, the coverage audit's 25 examiner questions as x01–x25). Run with backend/scripts/eval_assistant.py; never in CI (it calls the real model). page_shows and must_mention were read BEFORE the model is run (spec §8.5), for the organisation and date in recorded_for. The demo data is live: re-read the facts if the run is on a later day.

recorded_for.how: Read at ~22:15 SAST through each tool's own read (the pages' service functions) with the free dev script, no model. Six spot-checked by Tom against the pages in the browser: see the spec's §14 Stage 7 row.
recorded_for.core_run: 21 Oct 22:35 SAST, gemini-3.8-flash: 14 core questions (s01 x01 s06 s10 s19 s20 s34 s37 s38 s31 x02 x04 x14 s29), 12 PASS, 1 REVIEW (x01, numbers all from the tool), 1 FAIL in the grader only (s19 asked 05:00 or 17:00 correctly; kind was 'answer' because route_time ran first; expectation fixed), $0.46. The other 49 are for Tom to ask in his own time.
